title: How to Apply for a Cheque Book at ZX Bank

nodes.title: 1. **Via ZX Bank Mobile App**
nodes.summary: Request a cheque book in the ZX Bank Asia mobile app: log in (with biometrics allowed), go to Services / Request Services, tap Cheque Book Request, choose the account, enter the delivery address if it differs, and submit; a confirmation SMS/email with estimated delivery time follows.

nodes.title: 2. **Through NetBanking**
nodes.summary: In ZX Bank NetBanking, log in, go to Services > Cheque Book Request, select the account and number of leaves, verify the address, submit, and track the request under Request History.

nodes.title: 3. **At Branch**
nodes.summary: Visit a ZX Bank branch, fill the Cheque Book Request Form at the counter, submit it to a bank officer (with valid ID if required), and collect an acknowledgment receipt showing the expected dispatch date.

nodes.title: 4. **Via ZX Bank ATM**
nodes.summary: At any ZX Bank ATM, insert the debit card and PIN, go to Services > Cheque Book Request, select the account and number of leaves, and confirm the request to complete it.

nodes.title: 5. **ZX Bank Customer Care**
nodes.summary: Call the 24x7 toll-free helpline 1800-XXX-XXXX (India), verify your details with the executive, place the cheque book request, and note the reference number; key FAQs cover 3–7 working day dispatch, free first cheque book per year, status tracking, and updating your address first.

children.title: ℹ️ **Frequently Asked Questions**
children.summary: FAQ answers: dispatch takes 3–7 working days; the first cheque book of the year is usually free and subsequent ones incur charges; track status via the app or NetBanking; update your address before requesting to ensure correct delivery.
